evidence.provenance: Aggregate results recovered from Claude project memory; the original queries and per-query labels were not recoverable.

decisions.change: Selected gemini-embedding-001 with 768 dimensions for the retrieval index.

known_limitations: Labels are BM25 top-1 known-item targets, not exhaustive human relevance judgments.
The corpus is English-only and has five queries per collection.

decisions.change: Added deterministic fixed-vector evaluation after index rebuilds and a weekly launchd run. The bootstrap is a regression gate with no absolute recall floor until labels receive human review.
decisions.follow_up_trigger: Revise chunking or collection composition only after reviewed failures show a repeatable category-level pattern; record the before/after metrics here.
